mechanism: Repeat a compact vignette grammar across different spaces: ordinary setup, one autonomous action by the same active role, one visible material consequence, one reaction by the recurring witness, then a clean reset. Change the physical problem each round and increase consequence scale before a held final reaction.

invariants.rule: Keep the same active-role and witness relationship readable across every reset.
invariants.purpose: Makes separate rooms feel like one anthology.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing both roles turns the sequence into unrelated clips.

invariants.rule: Establish an ordinary object and action before each mishap.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on a mess removes responsibility and timing.

invariants.rule: Use a different material consequence in each round.
invariants.purpose: Creates variation rather than duplicate gags.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one mishap adds no proof.

invariants.rule: Increase consequence scale or spatial reach across rounds.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random intensity without a ladder feels arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Hold both roles and the largest consequence together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting before the reaction loses the payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source food, furniture or domestic props
the exact mishap order and reactions
the source wardrobe and family identity
